caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed shoe placed centrally against a plain, off-white background. The shoe has a wooden sole rendered in light grayish-beige with shaded grooves suggesting depth and texture. The upper part of the shoe is brown and adorned with intricate decorative patterns in a slightly darker brown hue. The back and front parts of the upper are higher and curve slightly inward. There is a small, rounded piece of similar brown material attached near the back of the shoe. The outlines and details are precisely drawn, with clear emphasis on the ornamental motifs covering the upper sections of the footwear. No additional objects or background elements are present in the composition.
title: Woman's Sandal
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
